Paragon Associates & Paragon Associates Ii Joint Venture increased its stake in Citigroup Inc (C) by 20.69% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Paragon Associates & Paragon Associates Ii Joint Venture bought 30,000 shares as the company’s stock declined 9.55% with the market. The institutional investor held 175,000 shares of the major banks company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $13.02M, up from 145,000 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Paragon Associates & Paragon Associates Ii Joint Venture who had been investing in Citigroup Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $185.79B market cap company. The stock increased 0.40% or $0.29 $72.86. About 11.53 million shares traded. Citigroup Inc. (NYSE:C) has risen 17.06% uptrending. It has outperformed by 5.51% the S&P500.
